note: workspace:// end to end on the local provider: /hello runs a command in a persistent workspace, /count writes a file one exec and reads it the next, /loop runs three passes inside one dispatch, /exit shows a non-zero exit merging as data. Needs --allow-local-workspace (the local provider is opt-in: commands run as your uid).

checks.name: a command runs in the workspace and its stdout merges
the chassis stamps provenance the command cannot forge
a file written by one exec is read by the next
workspace:// loops: three passes inside one dispatch
the loop stopped because the predicate held
a non-zero exit is data, not a dropped op
